pokedexEntries.su: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

pokedexEntries.mo: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

pokedexEntries.us: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

pokedexEntries.um: If you build sand mounds when you’re playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

pokedexEntries.sw: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

pokedexEntries.sh: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

pokedexEntries.sc: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

pokedexEntries.vi: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they're blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

pokedexEntries.za: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.
